comment: Each row runs the same four cases (scramblase.cpp:89 to :132). Above the threshold: output 1 and output 4 are the size of the input less twice its excess over the threshold, with the sign kept, which is a fold; output 2 is the threshold itself with the sign kept, a hard clip; output 3 is full scale with the sign kept. Below the threshold outputs 1, 2 and 3 pass the input and output 4 gives full scale with the sign kept. Everything is worked on the input divided by 5 and multiplied back by 5.
